text:
leila_cs: FYI renewal for ArcFlow due next week. Procurement wants split billing (US + EU) and a 6-month term. They also asked to start onboarding as soon as PO is uploaded. Need pricing and legal signoff.
mike_sales: looping in @dina_legal and @sam_fin. Any immediate no-go items?
dina_legal: We can do multi-entity invoices but SOW needs explicit billing lines and entity identifiers. Also add tax appendix for EU VAT handling. No blocker.
sam_fin: Finance point: 6mo normally prorates to ~54% of annual. To avoid cutting margin propose a +4% uplift on the pro-rated subtotal. Approve from product needed.
tess_onboard: We can run pre-kickoff workshops with view access, but full seat activation + SSO requires signed contract/PO. We can reserve 2 enablement seats.
leila_cs: Customer offered 6mo at +4% and wants the two onboarding credits kept. They're going to try to get PO uploaded tomorrow.
renewal-bot: Reminder — renewal:arcflow in 3 days. Tasks: pricing approval, DocuSign amendment, PO template.
mike_sales: I'll send PO template + amendment link and request vendor code. Will flag as non-standard in tracker.

PO template snippet shared with customer:
```
Billing Line A:
- Entity: ArcFlow Inc (EIN: 23-4567890)
- Scope: US seats + onboarding credits
Billing Line B:
- Entity: ArcFlow EU (VAT: NL123456789B01)
- Scope: EU seats
Vendor Code: ARC-009
Payment terms: Net30 (PO required)
```

leila_cs: Marking renewal row with 'split-billing' and 'start-on-PO' flags. Will proceed once PO is in.
